app.name: Sohbah Academy
app.description: Student registration, recitation queue, and attendance tracking in one place.

students.title: Join a circle
students.body: Register once with your name and your father's name. After that you join any circle by searching for your name – no account, no password.
students.note: Already registered? Open your circle's link instead.

teachers.title: Run your circles
teachers.body: Sign in to follow today's circles, record attendance, manage the recitation order, and share the circle link.
teachers.note: New accounts are reviewed by a supervisor before sign-in works.

newStudent.title: New student?
newStudent.body: Register once with your name and your father's name. After that you join any circle by searching for your name.

returningStudent.title: Already registered?
returningStudent.body: Open your circle's link and search for your name to join today's queue. No need to register again.
returningStudent.note: Your teacher shares the circle link with you.

register.title: Register a new student
register.subtitle: You only register once. After that you join any circle by searching for your name.

success.nextStep: Open your circle's link and search for your name to join the queue.

duplicate.title: A matching name is already registered
duplicate.body: If this is you, do not register again – go back to your circle's link and search for your name.
duplicate.hint: Registering twice splits your attendance across two records.

schedules.subtitle: Each board is one table on the public schedule page. Its rows are read live from the circles themselves, so you never retype a name.
